messages:
Marta: OK Q3 hosted API check-in — we need to lock scope for Embeddings quality improvements + Rerank productization. Can we confirm ship criteria by EOW? @Alex @Tao
Alex: Quick heads-up — eng capacity hits in July due to infra migration. We should define minimal acceptance tests before committing to dates.
Tao: For embeddings quality I propose two focused experiments: 1) cosine stability across seeded runs, 2) retrieval downstream eval (MRR/NDCG) on internal QA sets.
Marta: Draft acceptance criteria: embedding MRR >= 0.78 on vendor test, cosine variance < 0.02 across quantized builds, stability across restarts. Latency target: p95 <= 45ms for hosted embedding endpoint.
Jessie: Customer note — FinSys and HealthCo explicitly require deterministic embeddings for auditability. They want model pinning + changelog for any embedding model change.
Raj: For Rerank MVP: endpoints = batch rerank + streaming score output, features = top-k re-ranking, score + token-level explanation metadata. Acceptance: NDCG@10 uplift >= 8% vs our current baseline on their corpora.
Emily: Ops/infra caution — streaming + rerank memory usage can spike. Need fallback routing: if mem>80% route to smaller model or degrade to async job. Also require p95 latency SLA for combined call types.
Alex: Implementation plan outline: Phase 1 = API surface + basic telemetry + tests; Phase 2 = perf optimizations (KV cache for rerank, embedding caching, model quantization profiles). Phase 1 target: beta by 2026-08-15 (tentative, depends on infra).
Marta: Tradeoff discussion: Do we accept embedding determinism even if it causes ~10% latency increase in some configs? Customers say determinism is higher priority, but we need opt-in. Proposal: default = faster non-deterministic path, opt-in flag `deterministic=true` for audits.
Tao: Technical detail: 4-bit quantized builds introduce jitter. Mitigation: add stabilized post-processing (vector normalization + seeded hashing) — cost ~+3ms median, reduces variance significantly.
Jessie: CS ask: Sales needs a short FAQ describing determinism, expected perf impact, and migration steps. Raj can coordinate pilot customers.
Raj: Will reach out to top pilot candidates today and loop in sales. @Jessie I'll list contacts.
Marta: Owners recap: Alex = eng lead, Tao = ML, Emily = infra, Raj = customer pilots, Jessie = CS. Deliverables: acceptance doc, test harness, rollout plan + opt-in flag. I'll assemble PRD and share.
Alex: Need capacity estimate for perf tests. Can infra provide staging GPUs (A100/T4) next week?
Emily: Allocating two A100s in staging for perf, ETA Monday. Will also reserve a small T4 pool for cost-sensitive tests.
Marta: Decision: Hosted-first with opt-in deterministic flag, Dedicated/Reserved rollout later. Any objections?
Alex: +1
Tao: +1
Jessie: +1
Marta: Great. I'll circulate an acceptance criteria doc by EOD. Action items: create GH issues for `embedding_stability` and `rerank_ndcg` test suites, owner tags, and expected test data. ETA for issues: 48h.
deploy-bot: Heads-up: infra migration deploy scheduled 2026-07-20 02:00 UTC — this may impact July testing window.
Marta: Noted. Thanks all — I'll file follow-ups and ping owners on the issues.
